fix.notes: Player counts use a separate query to avoid double-counting matches (each match has two deck_match rows). Season boundary uses the same `seasons.last_rotation()` timestamp as the existing match-season stat. No schema changes needed.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The home page community stats section showed match counts (today/week/month/season/all time) but no information about how many unique players participated in league/tournament play over those time windows.

## What changed

**`decksite/data/match.py`** — `stats()` now runs a second SQL query that JOINs `match → deck_match → deck` and uses `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ... THEN d.person_id END)` to compute unique player counts for the last 7 days, last 30 days, current season, and all time. The results are merged into the existing dict so callers see both match stats and player stats from the same function.

**`decksite/views/home.py`** — `setup_stats()` adds a second entry to `self.community_stats` with header 'Unique Players' and the four new time-window player counts. The existing Mustache template already iterates `community_stats` so no template changes were needed.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip), 89 deselected (functional/perf) in ~19s against a live local MariaDB instance

Fixes #1558
fix.pr_title: Show unique player counts by week/month/season/all time on home page (#1558)

evidence.detail: Added match count stats (today/week/month/season/all-time) to home page — player counts were NOT included
stats() queries `match` table only; no JOIN to deck/deck_match/person means no player count is possible from this query
setup_stats() builds community_stats with only match count entries; no player count entries
Community Stats section renders community_stats list generically; adding a player-count group requires no template change

triage.fix_sketch: 1) In `decksite/data/match.py:stats()`, add a JOIN from `match` through `deck_match dm` to `deck d` and extend the SELECT with `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN FROM_UNIXTIME(m.date) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN d.person_id ELSE NULL END) AS num_players_this_week` (and similar for month/season/all-time). 2) In `decksite/views/home.py:setup_stats()`, add a second entry to `self.community_stats` with header 'Unique Players' and the four time-window player counts. No template changes needed.
triage.notes: Read-only SQL query change plus display wiring. No schema, no data-retention changes. The existing community_stats template already supports multiple stat groups.
